summary_en: This study tests BL-M14D1 given together with atezolizumab, compared with standard treatment, in people with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer who have not had prior treatment for it. BL-M14D1 and atezolizumab are given into a vein on day 1 of each 21-day cycle, and the length of treatment is not stated; the standard arm gets carboplatin, etoposide and atezolizumab for 4 cycles, followed by atezolizumab with or without lurbinectedin. The main outcome the study measures is not stated in the record; it is a Phase 3, randomized, open-label trial.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba BL-M14D1 administrado junto con atezolizumab, comparado con el tratamiento estándar, en personas con cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas en etapa extensa que no han recibido tratamiento previo para esta enfermedad. BL-M14D1 y atezolizumab se administran por vena el día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días; la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El brazo estándar recibe carboplatino, etopósido y atezolizumab durante 4 ciclos, seguidos de atezolizumab con o sin lurbinectedina. El resultado principal que mide el estudio no se indica en el registro; es un estudio de fase 3, aleatorizado y abierto.
who_for: Previously untreated extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, confirmed by pathology or cytology
Eligible for platinum-based chemotherapy combined with an anti-PD-L1 inhibitor
At least one measurable lesion by RECIST v1.1 per investigator assessment
not_for: Platinum or etoposide treatment for limited-stage small cell lung cancer within 6 months before enrollment
Prior topoisomerase inhibitor-based antibody-drug conjugate therapy
Other cancers, except certain skin cancers or curatively treated cancer with at least 3 years disease-free
